prompt: You are coordinating a research project and need to update a colleague about the publication timeline and next steps.

taskData.promptText: The research team will publish its findings next month.

scenario.role: You are coordinating a university research project.
scenario.relationship: Colleagues on the same research team
scenario.communicationGoal: Share the publication timeline and coordinate the next update.

requiredPoints: State that the findings will be published next month
Offer to update the project stakeholders
Ask whether the colleague has information to add
